top_findings.title: standings() computes from matches but merges overlapping datasets and groups by raw team name
top_findings.evidence: main.cpp:59 defaults competition="Brasileirao" and filters via contains() (main.cpp:52 = normalize().find()), so both "Brasileirao" (main.cpp:43) and "Brasileirao Historical" (main.cpp:47) are summed; map keyed on raw x[m.home]/x[m.away] (not normalize()), so _factual.json lists Palmeiras 902 AND Palmeiras-SP 622 as separate rows; factual_accuracy=0.0. R9 criterion 'computed from matches, not hardcoded' is met, so R9 is partial, not missing.
top_findings.suggestion: Use exact competition equality and normalize team names before using them as grouping keys.
